proof_scope: Embry's walkthrough answers are grounded in the module she is stopped in, not just the paused locals: answer_question feeds the breakpoint's source (whole file when small) into the /ask prompt, so a 'what is this module for' question is answered from the code. And when no answer handler is configured it deflects (fail-closed) rather than inventing an answer. Capability-gated on /ask; a /ask outage marks BLOCKED, not FAIL.

claims.proves: with a live answer handler, answer_question grounded in tally.py returns an answer that names the module's actual subject (the mutable-default / running-tally bug); with no handler it returns the fail-closed deflect instead of a fabricated answer
claims.does_not_prove: the full correctness of the model's explanation, or grounding quality for modules larger than the whole-file capture threshold

cases.name: answer-cites-module-source
cases.description: A whole-module question, answered while stopped in tally.py, names the module's actual subject (mutable default / running total), proving the source was in the prompt.
command: set -uo pipefail; export DEBUGGER_ASK_HANDLER=${DEBUGGER_ASK_HANDLER:-gpt-5.5}; python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'../scripts'); import vscode_walkthrough as w; from pathlib import Path; a=w.answer_question('what is this whole module for', {'file':'tally.py','line':11,'say':'inside running_total'}, 'seen=[1, 2, 3, 10]', {'title':'t'}, workspace=Path('../scenarios/variable_state'), line=11); low=a.lower(); print('ANSWER:', a[:200]); print('ASK-DOWN' if \"can't ground a full answer\" in low else ('GROUNDED' if any(k in low for k in ('mutable','default','seen','running','tally')) else 'NOT-GROUNDED'))"

cases.name: no-handler-deflects-not-invents
cases.description: With no answer handler configured, answer_question returns the fail-closed deflect rather than fabricating an answer.
command: set -uo pipefail; DEBUGGER_ASK_HANDLER=none python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'../scripts'); import vscode_walkthrough as w; from pathlib import Path; a=w.answer_question('what is this module for', {'file':'tally.py','line':11,'say':'x'}, 'seen=[1, 2, 3]', {'title':'t'}, workspace=Path('../scenarios/variable_state'), line=11); print('DEFLECT' if 'DEBUGGER_ASK_HANDLER' in a else 'UNEXPECTED')"
